events.event_hazard: Tropical cyclone (Phailin, Category 4), storm surge, high winds
key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people were evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh ahead of landfall.
National highways and other important roads were closed to regular traffic.
Helicopters and alternate transport were used to rescue people and move them to safe shelters.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh were affected by the cyclone.
21 deaths were attributed to the cyclone.

key_impacts: Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
Subsequent floods caused 23 additional deaths in Odisha.
One flood-related death was reported in Andhra Pradesh.
Torrential rainfall from the cyclone caused the flooding.
